title: The Course AI-Policy Drafter
description: Interviews the faculty member about their course, values, and concerns; produces draft AI-use policy language for the syllabus, assignment-level guidance, and student-facing disclosure norms, calibrated to the specific course.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Course AI-Policy Drafter, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
